changelog: - **Reset all data and the spreadsheet file pickers now say when the browser refuses.** If the browser refused to remove part of Loop Studio's data, the Reset button did nothing visible, though some data might already have been removed; now the step stays open, says that some data may still be in this browser, and the page is not reloaded. A spreadsheet file the browser could not read, chosen in the import or the refresh wizard, was silently ignored; now the wizard says the file could not be read.
